messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired PD-78942 — High 5xx rate on embeddings-prod (eu-west-1). Alert rule: embeddings-api > 5xx rate > 4% for 2m. Impact: increased client errors, latency spikes. Paging eng-oncall.
oncall-bot: Automated note: page routed to eng-oncall. Priority: high. Remember to ack in PD.
alex: acked in PD and on Slack. I'm on the bridge. quick check of metrics shows a fast spike starting ~10:12 UTC.
tara: I'm online, monitoring logs and checking if this correlates with the autoscaler change we rolled at 10:05. Will check the deploy history.
alex: running quick pod check: `kubectl get pods -n embeddings-prod -o wide` shows a lot of CrashLoopBackOff on node group euw-spot-a.
maria: tagging infra to see if nodes flapped. ping @sam if you can check node autoscaling events.
sam: looking now — saw a transient AZ disruption and the node autoscaler reacted, then we kicked off scale-up which caused many pods to reschedule at once. Might be cold-started model shards causing KV cache misses and transient memory pressure.
pausable-bot: (info) fanout suppression active: duplicated alert suppression prevented duplicate pages for the same symptom across routes.
alex: interesting — pagerbot still fired though. Could be the suppression window didn't include this rule path because it uses route-specific keys.
tara: confirming: the alert was from route `/v1/embeddings/batch` which has a separate fingerprint, so fanout suppression didn't match. We'll file a followup.
maria: mitigation idea: pin a temporary scaling-policy to keep >=4 pods on eu-west-1 for embeddings-prod and roll back the 10:05 autoscaler tweak. Thoughts?
sam: +1 for pin to stabilize. Starting manual scale-up now: `kubectl scale deploy embeddings --replicas=6 -n embeddings-prod`.
alex: scaling in progress. Meanwhile setting traffic fallback: route heavy clients to model-variant `embed-small-v2` to reduce mem pressure. Updating rollout policy now.
tara: started a quick customer-impact lookup: ~1.2k requests failed in the last 5m, affecting 2 enterprise customers (acme-corp and novaai) with ~30% of their requests hitting 5xx.
maria: drafting a short incident banner for status.redwood.ai and pinging CS. Copy: "We're investigating elevated errors for embeddings in eu-west-1. Some requests may fail intermittently. Mitigation in progress." Approve?
alex: approve — send. Also add a note we expect reduced errors after scale up.
sam: scale-up done, pods are stabilizing; new pods ready. Observability shows 5xx rate dropping from 8% -> 1.5% over 60s.
tara: confirming metrics look better, latency also trending down. I'll keep monitoring for 15m to ensure no regression.
alex: handoff: I need to jump to another pager rotation in 12m. @sam can you take ownership after I leave? I'll give a brief on what we've done in the incident ticket.
sam: I can take it. I'll keep the bridge and own followups, plus a short postmortem to include fanout suppression gaps.
maria: cc'ing CS: sent status banner and customer DM templates to @support-team.
inc-bot: Incident ticket INC-2026 created — tags: embeddings, eu-west-1, paging. Assigned to sam for follow-up.
tara: next-step checklist for post-incident: (1) revert autoscaler tweak or expand minimum replica target, (2) improve fanout suppression keys to dedupe route-level alerts, (3) add KV cache warmup for quick reschedules, (4) run a chaos test for node flaps.
alex: thanks team — leaving in good shape. Sam owns postmortem and follow-ups. I'll add detailed logs to INC-2026. :thumbsup:
sam: taking over. I'll post a 1-hour status update and then schedule a brief async postmortem sync. If anything spikes, alert me directly (sam).
